text:
Priya: Heads-up: I'm in Toronto next Tues for customer meetings. Anyone know a quick spot near King & Spadina for sandwiches or something that takes groups of 6?
Ethan: Porchetta + roast beef at Banh Mi Boys is solid and fast, but small seating. Good for pickup.
Noah: For a sit-down go to Buca Osteria for Italian, they have a big table and decent lunch specials.
Jules: If people want healthy, Freshii on King has bowls and is super quick.
Priya: Plan is 12:15 walk-in. If it's a pickup, I'll grab and bring to the conference room.
Ethan: Also, if you want tofu/veg friendly, Pai Northern Thai has a nice lunch menu.
Noah: Quick poll: reply with 1 word - porchetta, buca, freshii, pai
Ethan: porchetta
Jules: buca
Priya: porchetta
Noah: buca
kudos-bot: Congrats to Priya for landing the demo with Acme Corp! :tada:
Priya: thanks!! low-key celebratory lunch would be great. I'll order from Banh Mi Boys and bring napkins.
Ethan: If pick-up, can you save a veg option?
Priya: yup will grab tofu porchetta for Jules. Meeting spot: King & Spadina lobby, 12:15 Tuesday.
Priya: I'll post an update with ETA and pickup details morning-of.
